name: Liverpool
notes: Sales are category A (standard price paid) only.
Land Registry registers sales weeks to months after completion, so the latest two to three months are always incomplete and fill in with later updates.
Price trends come from the UK House Price Index, which is mix-adjusted and published for the local authority (Liverpool), not for the postcode district.
